name: Yuandian Web / H5
purpose: Render the same product loop as the miniapp on the official website without importing miniapp UI code.
designRule: Keep brand language aligned with the miniapp, but implement Web layout, routing, responsive behavior, and export flows inside apps/web only. Subpages expose a compact six-entry scene switch, mirroring the miniapp entry-detail child scene without importing WXML/WXSS.

primaryEntries.label: 学习主界面
primaryEntries.job: Show the whole learning loop at a glance and route users into the next best action.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Desktop gets a left rail plus one main action panel; mobile gets a compact tab-like launch board.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Home launches the six entries; subpages use Web-owned navigation rather than miniapp child-scene code.

primaryEntries.label: 上传资料
primaryEntries.job: Classify talent reports, grades, wrong questions, school feedback, and parent notes.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use larger drop zones, material cards, a right-side evidence checklist, and the compact six-entry scene switch above the upload console.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Compact switch keeps upload, report, tutor, review, parent, and map one click apart.

primaryEntries.label: 个性化报告
primaryEntries.job: Explain evidence, talent-method fit, learning plan, and PDF export.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use report chapters, visual evidence panels, sticky export/share actions, and the compact six-entry scene switch above the report evidence panel.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Report stays evidence-first, then routes to tutor, review, parent, or material补充.

primaryEntries.label: AI私教
primaryEntries.job: Start with the first Socratic question and keep the answer-safe tutoring boundary.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a two-column tutor workspace: dialogue on the left, evidence and next action on the right, plus the compact six-entry scene switch.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Tutor keeps the first-step surface one click from review and parent evidence.

primaryEntries.label: 短回访
primaryEntries.job: Validate memory, transfer, and wrong-cause repair through lightweight recall loops.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use one active verification task per screen, with progress, streak, transfer prompts, and the compact six-entry scene switch.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Review keeps memory and transfer visible without becoming a long explanatory page.

primaryEntries.label: 家长中心
primaryEntries.job: Summarize evidence, reassurance, parent question, and next step.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a decision board: what we know, what changed, what to do tonight, with the compact six-entry scene switch above the parent proof summary.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Parent can jump back to report evidence, upload补充, or review validation.

primaryEntries.label: 今晚路径
primaryEntries.job: Show the full learning route across tonight and the next 7 days.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a visual route board that connects upload, report, tutor, review, parent check, next evidence, and the compact six-entry scene switch.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Map is the Web counterpart of entry-detail?scene=today.

primaryEntries.label: 龙虾 AI 教师
primaryEntries.job: Let a parent configure one parent-device AI teacher that combines parent analysis, child co-view tutoring, emotional support, and scheduled follow-up.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a parent-device teacher workspace with install options, co-view mode, proactive follow-up, and a link to the standalone lobster activation shell.
primaryEntries.childScenePattern: Web-only product expansion; does not add or revive miniapp tabs.
